ruleDefinitions.name: Possible PetitPotam Coerce Authentication Attempt
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect PetitPotam coerced authentication activity. Note: Unmapped fields: ShareName, RelativeTargetName

sequences.query: (event_id = 5145 AND ShareName = RGX("^\\\\\\\\") AND ShareName = RGX("\\\\IPC\\$$") AND RelativeTargetName = "lsarpc" AND user = "ANONYMOUS\ LOGON")
